notes:
### Added

- Built-in update checker — polls pressware.co manifest once per 24 hours on launch
- "Check for Updates" menu item for manual update checks
- Red dot badge on menu bar icon when a new version is available
- Update section in dropdown with version number, "More Info", and "Download" buttons
- "More Info" opens a native release notes panel with full changelog and download link
- Dismiss logic — suppresses notification until a new version or 30 days elapse
- `make publish` target to copy DMG and generate manifest for pressware.co
- `make release` target chaining `dist` then `publish` for one-command releases
- `make test-update` target for local update checker testing
- `BURNRATE_UPDATE_URL` environment variable override for testing
- "You're up to date" confirmation after manual update check finds no newer version

### Fixed

- Keychain password prompts no longer stack — credentials are cached in memory after first read (#10)
- Auto-refresh timer no longer queues Keychain dialogs after auth failure — pauses until manual refresh (#2)
